label: Occam's razor and the headcount of a finite explanation versus an infinite regress
paraphrase: A headcount advantage surviving every finite addition is exactly a finite charged inventory against an infinite one. An acyclic regress supplies an infinite charged inventory if its visited bearers have distinct charges. A shared countable infinity of other objects can make two total inventories equipotent despite this advantage in additions.
